consistencyResults.summary: Exactly twelve stable facility/activity/opportunity identities resolve across the Phase 14 registry and all successor packages.
Phase 17 owns twelve unique facility-specific physical anchors; six broad predecessor aliases require one explicit facility-scoped canonicalization map before runtime binding.
All discovery scenes resolve in ordered Book I content, capability/opening remains separate, and the original four retain passive Gold, upgrades, Oaths/offline behavior, and Family assignment.
All 79 tutorial IDs resolve with valid speakers/triggers/steps; 32 facility-concept mappings prove gradual contextual coverage for all twelve facilities.

All 18 Fellows and 20 Family retain unique profile quotes, ambient assignments, Phase 13 primary content, and later story/facility hooks. Story ranks and eligible fallbacks prevent premature locked-Fellow speech.
Fourteen immutable source/domain finalizer seams, manual exact-once claims, the 512/128 archive policy, and permanent replay authorities are coherent; implementations do not yet exist.
Regular opportunities remain non-expiring/manual; offline may bank to cap and mature Gardens only, never choose, resolve, harvest, replant, or claim.
Unapproved economy, progression, multiplier, art, and CSS values remain null and all affected definitions remain production-disabled.
All 27 Phase 20–21 release gates remain required, blocked, and evidence-null.

knownCrossPhaseVariances.resolution: Keep the Phase 17 facility-specific anchor and migrate/alias the facility-scoped predecessor value; never infer an anchor from the broad location alone.

scopeStatement: This result validates design consistency only. It does not implement, enable, balance, visually approve, or release any runtime feature.
